diagnostic_threshold_scope: Reporting convenience only; not reader qualification, physical acceptance or an independent-object gate.
sampling: Same sample_segments at voxel_size/2; sampled_points concatenates those samples with unchanged original points and supplies no segments. Readers receive only arrays, voxel_size and fixed zero origin.
development_replay: Directly reference all 44 previously scored normal NPZ inputs by their original frozen hashes. Privileged prepare copies their paired construction truth into the new isolated truth manifest. This cohort is explicitly development replay, not fresh holdout evidence.
new_section_cohort: Generate 36 new authored conditions: nine families, two voxel scales, two physical axial sampling densities, fixed sampling phase 0.37 and seed 421017. No output or score for these conditions is seen before freeze. These repeat analytic families and are not independent physical objects.
old_baseline: Preserve and receipt all 176 original rows, including abstention; do not rerun the old abstention arm. The new paired arms are evidence and the unchanged original ridges reader.
freeze_policy: Freeze dependencies, separate truth and all 80 unlabelled inputs before new normal inference. Verify all 320 ordered normal output receipts before evaluation may read either cohort's truth. Do not blend old and new cohorts into a fresh holdout claim, sweep thresholds after scores, or overwrite earlier attempts.
qualification: Two separately reported development/analytic cohorts, not a general reader qualification or G1 pass. Empty positive output remains failed recovery. Negative or unresolved empty output is construction-conditioned abstention, not automatic foreground recognition. Retain errors, failures and regressions.
